title: Viral host assignment across the tree of life with VHAMSTeR
summary: VHAMSTeR yields specific host-assignment and metagenomic ecological findings from a sequence model; the predicted host associations remain computational.
ai_technology: a fine-tuned genomic language model and biological genome/homology features feed separate classifiers, combined by a context-aware gate for five-category host assignment.
organization: Affiliation not stated in the reviewed material

evidence.tested: VHAMSTeR yields specific host-assignment and metagenomic ecological findings from a sequence model; the predicted host associations remain computational.
evidence.unknown: Methods/Results: trained on 42,512 viral sequences; 5-fold cross-validation clustered by genome identity to limit leakage, plus comparisons with prior tools. Ecological host links are computational predictions and are not in-source experimental confirmation.
evidence.ai_role: a fine-tuned genomic language model and biological genome/homology features feed separate classifiers, combined by a context-aware gate for five-category host assignment.

source_review.scope: Primary result-bearing material for the stated method, result and evaluation, with bibliographic version information.
